status: SANITIZED DESIGN SPECIFICATION; NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION OR ACCEPTANCE RECORD

typography.measurement: Measure loaded glyphs at the delivered scale; preserve codepoints, subscripts and units. Report unsupported coverage.
typography.fitting: Do not force width, stretch, tracking or text-fitting transforms. Wrap or resize the content region. Preserve legitimate notation rotations. Uniform viewer zoom is separate.

illustration_profiles.selected: Drafted front, profile and orthographic exterior cues
illustration_profiles.semantic_boundary: Decorative cues do not establish physical geometry, dimensions, counts, containment or allocation.

containers.form: Square-corner content-fit single frame with useful information partitions
containers.partition_layout: Header, body and footer cells may share one frame when each carries useful information. They do not create model compartments or containment.
containers.purple_policy: Retain a reworked purple option; no universal exclusion.

body_treatment.policy: Keep essential text, numbers and symbols visually distinct from the body. These options do not add palette families.

body.exceptions: Narrow screens scroll/reflow; do not silently shrink

annotation.exceptions: Never hide essential meaning in unreadable text

related_gap.exceptions: Measured labels may require larger gaps

bend_clearance.applicability: Distance from bends/terminals to nearby obstacles or labels; never a route-to-endpoint gap
bend_clearance.exceptions: Endpoint connection gap is zero; preserve source attachment side/order and node boundaries

container_width.exceptions: Notation-specific nodes and content fit override

line_weight.applicability: Opaque essential strokes on native sheets
line_weight.exceptions: Source notation or deliberate emphasis may differ

body_leading.exceptions: Dense symbolic notation may need an explicit exception

line_weight.applicability: Ordinary graphic samples at native 1600 px; source notation prevails
line_weight.exceptions: No automatic style change to typed relations

standard_padding.exceptions: Nested ports and labels may need more space

conditional_profiles.resolution: Profiles apply to different content and scale conditions. Do not combine them into a universal range. Model notation, content fit and delivery scale take precedence.

line_and_texture_samples.unit: CSS px at the large graphic reference scale
line_and_texture_samples.texture_policy: Exploratory decoration only in nonessential regions. Preserve declared material or equipment hatches and stipple. Decorative patterns do not establish material properties or relation types.
line_and_texture_samples.essential_content: Use opaque contrasting fields and retain noncolor distinctions.

diagram_families.status: DESCRIPTIVE LABELS ONLY; NOT A PRODUCT SUPPORT MATRIX
diagram_families.support_rule: Each supported family needs an explicit admitted model contract, notation rules and tests. Unsupported families remain unsupported.

notation_invariants: The authoritative engineering model determines element identity, ownership, type, applicability, units, thresholds and obligations.
Preserve declared relation direction and kind, port identities, endpoint attachments, side and order, multiplicity and cardinality.
Keep junctions distinct from independent crossings; do not infer a junction from a visual intersection.
Use arrowheads only where declared direction or sequence warrants them. Preserve composition-diamond ownership, control versus object flow, fork/join and state-exit semantics.
Preserve declared resistor, transistor, switch and other specialized notation; a decorative pictogram is not a typed model element.
Actual connections meet their declared contacts. Clearance applies to labels and obstacles. Preserve explicitly nonattached marks and documented gaps without inventing links.
Do not create model containment, allocations or counts from boxes, facets, fasteners, icon marks or visual groupings.
Unknown or ambiguous meaning remains explicit. An illustration does not become a formal systems model through styling.

crispness_method.goal: Legible text, deliberate stroke hierarchy and clear separation at the delivery scale
measurement: Compare baseline and candidate at the same canvas, browser renderer, device-pixel ratio and display scale.
Compute effective painted widths through scene, element, pattern and instance transforms; nominal attributes alone are insufficient.
Inspect text bounds, clipping, overlaps, arrowheads, dash patterns, hatch density, connections and crossings.
Preserve editable vectors and text with qualified embedded fonts. Generate higher-resolution rasters by fresh vector rendering.
Use normal antialiasing for curves and diagonals; do not apply a universal crispEdges override.
limits: A thicker or thinner stroke does not universally improve sharpness.
Thumbnail fit factors do not establish equal text size or physical scale.
Nominal CSS pixels per inch do not calibrate a monitor or printer.
Visual preference and numerical checks do not establish engineering acceptance or reader comprehension.

acceptance_proposals.status: PROPOSED; EXECUTION AND ENGINEER ACCEPTANCE NOT CLAIMED

gates.name: Model projection
gates.expectation: Check identity, ownership, endpoint kinds, topology, notation, units, cardinalities and text against the admitted model.

gates.name: Meaningful refusal tests
gates.expectation: Use synthetic negative fixtures for wrong endpoints, missing required inputs, altered model inputs and unsupported notation. Required unknown, errored or incomplete checks cannot yield overall success.

gates.name: Typography
gates.expectation: Check actual loaded faces, glyph coverage, codepoints, subscripts, metrics, font notices and absence of silent fallback.

gates.name: Layout and contrast
gates.expectation: Check clipping, collisions, label and port clearances, contact attachment, arrowheads and measurable contrast at intended scales. Do not use color alone for essential meaning.

gates.name: Artifact generation
gates.expectation: Regenerate from trusted model data; inspect native vectors and fresh raster exports. If offline viewing is delivered, test it without network resources and verify saved source identity.

gates.name: Repository integration
gates.expectation: Run required scoped and repository regressions on the assigned integration base. Preserve existing public interfaces and reject execution of code embedded in model data.

gates.name: Review and acceptance
gates.expectation: Keep semantic review, visual review, engineering acceptance and physical qualification separate. Hashes identify bytes rather than authenticate decisions.

gates.name: Reuse rights
gates.expectation: Use synthetic fixtures, original reusable artwork or explicitly permitted attributed derivatives. Include required licenses with redistributed fonts and assets.

additional_qualification: Graphical-editor edit, save and reopen where editable delivery is claimed.
Print, grayscale and monitor-scale qualification for the intended medium.

delivery_boundary: This document contains reusable presentation values and proposals only. It embeds no source figures, models, artwork, font binaries or evidence records and grants no rights to omitted material.

function_tree_implementation.scope: Current selected compact tree treatment restores same-family blue, tangerine and green branches with an orange-on-violet root. Independent fill, frame/accent and connector resolution and nondefault pair candidates remain available. No universal engineering meaning; leaf body choices remain provisional.
